b:
It was my
preschool age

At home,
a great commotion

To comb my hair,
to put powder on me,
to dress me:
in my
family
there was never
a shortage of people

Before everyone
was ready
I fell asleep

When I woke
I was in
Amma's lap

Before my eyes,
a white cloth,
chairs
row after row

In front of me
and behind me,
my relatives,
the ones I had learned to name

Suddenly,
pitch darkness

On the white cloth,
coloured pictures

What I had seen
on the small box
was huge
today

I remember
reading
those letters,
"Madhura"

Suddenly
bits of paper
flew and fell
on me.
I did not understand
that it was the whistling
for the hero's entry

The fan
hung on the wall
blew the cigarette smoke
from the back seats
into my face as well

When I dozed off halfway
and woke up,
the film was over

"Next time
we'll go to a good film,"
said
Akka

Years later
we went as a family
to see "Vettaikaaran"
note: "Madhura" (2004) and "Vettaikaaran" (2009) are both films starring the Tamil actor Vijay. Akka means elder sister.
